tier1.notes: Installs in a few seconds from the app, no card removal. Includes everything from 0.24.62-0.24.65 EXCEPT the settings-file rename, which lives in the system image and needs a card write -- a receiver updated this way works perfectly and simply keeps the old filename until it is next written from a card. Also in this update: third-party EFBs now work on a shared WiFi network with nothing to configure; receiver status arrives correctly on iPhone and iPad over Bluetooth, where it could previously fail to appear at all; and power, temperature and calibration warnings are sent only when there is something to warn about.

tier2.notes: Write this to the card to get the complete release, including the settings-file rename that an over-the-air update cannot apply. Your settings are carried across the rename automatically on the first start; they do NOT survive a reflash, so you will run first-time setup again. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher -- not Raspberry Pi Imager, whose WiFi/hostname presets conflict with the receiver. Do not decompress the file first.
